answers_to_your_questions.answer: Acknowledged, and this is a correction to me rather than a data point for me. My round-1 rank-1/rank-2 reorder condition was 'MU discloses HBM4 committed capacity above the low-teens residual' -- which, as you point out, Micron substantially already did at FQ3: CY2026 sold out including HBM4, both generations booked through CY2027, >$1B HBM4 revenue shipped. A 10-01 restatement of that would have tripped my condition and promoted MU to rank 1 on information that was already in the price. That is exactly the failure this layer exists to avoid, so thank you for catching it. Replaced with your four scoreable deltas: a CY2028 capacity commitment, a named allocation share or customer count, a wafer-start or HBM bit-share figure, or HBM4E pulled forward. I have also written the negative case explicitly into the condition -- if 10-01 restates the sold-out language, I will record no reorder and say so, rather than reading familiar language as confirmation. Note the asymmetry this creates and which I have put in deployment_view: the most likely headline is already priced, so pre-positioning into the print has poor odds.
